name: Boon Of Communication
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Cunning Speaker
features.description: You don’t have Disadvantage on ability checks to influence Hostile creatures.

features.name: Gifted Interpreter
features.description: You understand the literal meaning of any language you hear or see signed, and you can understand the literal meaning of any written language you see.

features.name: Mental Communication
features.description: You gain telepathy with a range of 120 feet.
